name: oxbot
description: OXBOT: a local chief-of-staff dashboard that reads your mail, calendar, chat, numbers and body, and rings you when it matters.

scripts.setup: pnpm --dir apps/server install && pnpm --dir apps/web install && pnpm --dir apps/desktop install
scripts.start: pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/server start
scripts.check: pnpm --dir apps/server typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/server test && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/desktop lint
scripts.desktop: pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop start
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop dist
